ores.std/trace.disabled_hot_path: zero clock reads and zero event allocations
ores.std/trace.sinks: bounded local buffer; asynchronous export separately

oreslang-otel.transport: existing library JSONL only; OTLP not implemented

future_contract.scope: span created by Tracer; separate active-context scope; finish once on normal/error/cancel
future_contract.propagation: inject/extract W3C headers at trust boundary; preserve context across await, actor send/receive, restart generation fencing
future_contract.export: bounded async collector; OTLP exporter optional and capability-gated; no hot-path I/O
automatic_hooks: compiler-selected function and method entry/exit without annotations
HTTP server receive and response lifecycle
actor message send/admit/receive and supervisor lifecycle
future_contract.attribute_policy: static low cardinality keys; route templates not raw URLs; no credentials, headers, bodies, query strings or raw payloads
future_contract.default: off, opt in and sample; existing core log/debug/perf flags are independent

auto_instrumentation.goal: zero-code tracing; no application-level imports, annotations or wrappers needed

mechanisms.compiler: typed HIR/MIR instrumentation of selected callable bodies and async state machine exits
mechanisms.runtime: fixed scheduling, actor, mailbox, continuation, channel and critical admission lifecycle probes
mechanisms.stdlib: semantic spans at Atto-native HTTP, network, filesystem, database and messaging boundaries
mechanisms.foreign_ffi: only native adapter hooks at explicit capability boundaries; never promise arbitrary third-party internals

build.trace_capable: compile fixed low-cardinality boundaries; emit optional callable probes only if selected by build profile; all tracing disabled at runtime until explicit opt-in
build.trace_stripped: elide optional probes entirely; cannot turn on missing call-site coverage without rebuilding

options.scopes: compile-time include/exclude stable fully qualified symbols; use snake_case and avoid dynamic user strings
options.precedence: build-time coverage is an upper bound; runtime can enable a subset but cannot add missing probes

runtime.sampling: parent-based deterministic root sampling, bounded for traces and spans; sampled=false context remains propagate-able when explicitly authorized
runtime.config: operator CLI or package config; no application source edits
runtime.backpressure: drop eligible telemetry, increment bounded drop counters, never block actor execution

configuration.environment_cannot_grant: network/filesystem/trace-export capabilities and cross-tenant context propagation
configuration.otel_disabled_semantics: OTEL_SDK_DISABLED disables recording and export; any explicit propagation policy remains independent as specified by OTEL_PROPAGATORS
configuration.attributes: allowlisted semantic attributes; bounded key/value sizes and cardinality

probe_abi.purpose: compiler intrinsic/runtime internal only, not a callable userland hook interface
probe_abi.recording: disabled guard and sampler must run before timestamp or expensive argument construction
probe_abi.storage: preallocated bounded actor/scheduler shards or nonblocking collector try_send; no guest object references
probe_abi.site_id: stable compiler-defined numeric canonical symbol/operation identity; disambiguated independently of source line offsets
probe_abi.error_handling: telemetry failure never replaces guest error, modifies authorization, or suppresses supervisor CONTROL notice
probe_abi.lifecycle: exactly once completed spans where execution unwinds normally, including cancel/recover; fatal process abort may only preserve bounded crash-safe data opportunistically
probe_abi.async: trace context attached to owned continuation and message envelope; not OS/JVM thread local
probe_abi.deduplication: one semantic HTTP/DB operation span; optional lower-level TCP events are children/metrics and must not duplicate operation spans
probe_abi.host_boundary: separate runtime-internal diagnostic events from optional exported application-safe spans

propagation.default_off: do not capture, export or automatically forward untrusted context unless propagation explicitly permitted
propagation.enabled_unsampled: preserve immutable valid W3C parent context even for nonrecording spans, without allocating local span events
propagation.carrier: logical task, continuation, channel envelope or actor-mail metadata; no pointers or mutable guest span transfer
propagation.messaging: producer and consumer spans plus links when topology is fan-out/batch; single-parent rules otherwise
propagation.security: strict W3C parsing, baggage allowlist, quotas, actor incarnation/generation and tenant trust checks
propagation.restart: revoked generation cannot revive context on late callback

behavior_gates: compiled stripped profiles contain no optional probe references
trace-capable binary toggles emission via operator config without rebuild
real user guest has no instrumentation calls and still emits HTTP/actor spans when enabled
real guest return/error/cancel/panic/mailbox/critical behavior equals uninstrumented run
sampling and nonrecording propagation align with OpenTelemetry
runtime cross-backend verifiers execute actual guest and I/O rather than source-only simulations

namespaces.ores.core/trace: proposed freestanding immutable TraceId, SpanId, SpanContext, TraceFlags and local propagation descriptors; no OS clocks, I/O or exporters
namespaces.ores.std/trace: existing hosted Atto timing Event and bounded Buffer, manual span utilities; preserve std/trace alias
namespaces.ores.std/telemetry: proposed hosted Tracer/Span/metrics API and bounded asynchronous collector/export; optional in user applications
namespaces.internal/probe_abi: not importable from guest code; compiler and trusted runtime-only entry/exit/suspend/resume hooks

scoped_using.compatibility: retains existing contextual using resource.borrow() as view and does not repurpose using effect declarations
scoped_using.compiler_ast: lexical BlockStmt with single-evaluation binding and checked TryStmt finally closing span.end()
scoped_using.protocols: future normative using Scope with typed no-throw, non-suspending end; module alias must resolve to trusted ores.std/telemetry
behavior: evaluate span expression exactly once before entering body
activate scope on entry and restore previous logical TraceContext on exit
close exactly once on fallthrough, return, guest failure, throw, raise and cancellation
async suspension stores immutable parent context in owned continuation, not host thread
actor loan/generation/tenant enforcement; no mutable Span across actor mail
cleanup cannot mask original guest failure, panic CONTROL or cancellation
return type and guest-visible effects unchanged
current_limitations: Java parser currently lowers exact telemetry.span(...) as a binding plus try/finally; trusted SpanScope type/provenance is not yet checked
native ores.std/telemetry.atto no-op Span provider added with span() and span(name) and idempotent end(); real guest tests authored but NOT_EXECUTED
automatic runtime context activation/restoration and asynchronous collector/OTLP export NOT_IMPLEMENTED
LLVM frontend and source guest lowering NOT_IMPLEMENTED

dynamic_activation.no_redeploy_if: all desired sites pre-emitted, or JIT enabled with retained validated HIR/MIR and ability to compile new instrumented bodies
allowed_mechanisms: trace-capable AOT pre-emitted dormant probe slots toggled atomically by trusted operator
Java/Graal Truffle Assumption invalidation and deoptimization then recompilation of existing probe-capable nodes
future governed LLVM ORC JIT of retained typed MIR with versioned function-dispatch cells and quiescent epoch swap
rejected_mechanisms: replacing live function bodies without generation fencing

backend_constraints.java_graal_jvm: runtime mode toggles precompiled probe sites; assumption invalidates optimized call targets; JIT must be enabled
backend_constraints.java_graal_native_image: only precompiled optional probes and runtime gate unless separately verified hybrid JIT; Native Image alone cannot inject absent call sites
backend_constraints.llvm_aot: no new probes if stripped; pre-emitted sites can toggle; governed ORC JIT only in explicit hybrid profile with retained verified MIR and W^X policy
backend_constraints.wasm: only retained precompiled hooks; host worker code may be separately redeployed under approved policy, not patched by userland
backend_constraints.forge: JIT can replace versioned compiled code from validated IR with quiescence; AOT only has precompiled hooks
backend_constraints.net_native_aot: precompiled probes only, no arbitrary runtime IL emission or JIT

control.max_coverage: compiled coverage ceiling is never exceeded
control.generation: atomically publish new policy, invalidate old assumptions, fence stale callbacks and collector context
control.change_semantics: eventually visible to future call entries; in-flight spans close under captured policy; no hard real-time recompile on critical path
control.off_semantics: no new event allocation, clock read, formatting, I/O or user callback after policy disabled and quiesced
control.restore: old functions/binaries retained until last active frame finishes; reject unsupported profile

e2e_http_actor_client_otlp.goal: first actual unmodified .atto handler receiving inbound request, sending immutable trace context through actor mail, making outbound HTTP, and delivering parented spans to OTLP receiver
steps: compile same .atto fixture in Java/Graal JIT trace-capable mode and run guest server
issue inbound HTTP request with valid W3C traceparent; verify SERVER span created automatically
send actor message and verify immutable Context metadata attached outside payload and reconstructed on receive
perform outbound loopback HTTP request and verify injected traceparent parent/span and CLIENT span without manually supplied headers
capture async native collector batch with bounded queue and dropped counter through OTLP receiver
assert correct trace IDs, parent/child or link semantics, no secrets/raw URLs/credentials, nonblocking producer
rerun exact same compiled .atto source under LLVM; require real native code compilation/execution and equivalent context/span topology
required_evidence: actual backend compiler command and exit
e2e_http_actor_client_otlp.forbidden_shortcut: synthetic trace fixtures, source-free checkers, Java-only fake userland spans and zero-step Actions never count as E2E PASS
blockers: missing compiler-inserted probe entry/exit to application spans
no complete native std HTTP server/client ownership and loopback path on both Java and LLVM
no W3C propagation in actor send and HTTP client
